issues.title: The merged-ship modal (2+ ready cards selected, d) opens with focus on the release-name Input, so at the modal's own 60x15 minimum the Launch/Cancel row is scrolled out of view until the user presses Enter/Tab once - and no test covers this size/content combination
issues.description:
Found during the phase 4 hands-on tmux drive of the real 0.36.0 binary (not go test -overlay) while independently re-verifying REV-006's 60x15 minimum fix. Fixture: two awaiting-uat + report/ cards ('ship-ready-report', 'ship-ready-two') under a real project source (root '/Users/bartlomiej.zawadzki/gg-e2e-fixture-repo', 46 chars), both selected with Space, then `d` at exactly 60x15 (modalMinTermW/modalMinTermH).

Measured (tmux capture-pane, plain text, numbered lines): the box renders top-to-bottom as 'Release name for the merged entry' / the two slugs / the editable '> ship-ready' value / a blank line / the wrapped 'will run: claude "/gogo:done ..."' preview (5 wrapped lines at 60 columns) / a blank line / the help hint 'enter next' - and the box's bottom border appears immediately after that. The 'Launch     Cancel' row is NOT anywhere in the 15 visible rows. Pressing Enter (exactly what the hint bar says: 'enter next') advances focus from the Input into the Confirm field, and the SAME capture then shows the Input's own header line scrolled off and the 'Launch     Cancel' row now visible on row 11, with the hint bar changing to '.../ enter submit'. So the group has focus-follow scrolling (the same mechanism huh's Select viewport uses), but the group's INITIAL focus (the Input, first field) does not include the Confirm row in the initial viewport at this height - unlike the go Select, whose SEEDED option (a launch) is guaranteed visible per REV-006's fix and this round's independent verification.

Why this is worth a separate ticket and not folded into REV-006's verification: REV-006's own title says the merged-ship modal 'loses its Launch/Cancel row entirely' at 12-14 rows, and its fix_summary claims 'every cell the reviewer probed with a real-length root renders all options at >=15' - true for the go Select (both unforced and forced, independently reconfirmed this round with a different slug/root), but for the merged-ship arm specifically 'renders' at h=15 only happens AFTER one Enter/Tab, not on the confirm's first paint. It is not a dead end (the hint bar literally names the key that reveals it, matching the accepted precedent for the forced go-Select's down-arrow-reachable Cancel), so this is minor, not a regression of REV-006's own named defect. It is a real UX rough edge (a user reading only the initial screen sees no visible way to launch or cancel) and, more importantly, an uncovered case: TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal's 'merged ship' arm (cli/internal/tui/launch_modal_test.go) is only sized at {200,40},{120,30},{90,24},{80,20} - it never reaches the 60x15 minimum - and it only asserts the FR11 bound (line count <= h, width <= w per line), never that 'Launch'/'Cancel' text is present at all. REV-006's own proposed_solution explicitly suggested 'add a merged-ship case asserting the Launch and Cancel strings are present at the modal minimum', but the fix_summary only mentions extending the go-Select tests - this specific case was not added, so nothing pins the merged-ship group's initial-viewport content at the boundary.

code-review-standards.md #8 ('a user-visible state a handler sets must actually be rendered by View()') applies at a stretch: the Confirm IS eventually rendered (after one keypress), so this is a softer instance than a true violation, but the FIRST render at the advertised minimum omits the confirm's own action row.
issues.proposed_solution:
AGENT-FIXABLE, two independent parts.
1. TESTS (required): add the 60x15 (and one-row-below, 60x14) cells to TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal's 'merged ship' case, or a new dedicated test, asserting the CONTENT (not just the bound): at first paint, assert what IS visible (the release-name Input, the command preview); then simulate one Enter/Tab (tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter} or KeyTab through the model, mirroring how openGoConfirm/keyPress already drive the form) and assert 'Launch' and 'Cancel' are now both present - pinning the ACTUAL behavior (focus-follow reveals it after one key) rather than leaving it unasserted. If the maintainer instead wants the Confirm visible on first paint, that is a product change (option 2 below) and the test should assert THAT instead.
2. PRODUCT (optional, maintainer's call - not required to close this ticket, since the current behavior is reachable and matches the forced-go-Select precedent already accepted in REV-006): if a first-paint-visible Confirm row is wanted for a merged ship at small terminals, either (a) raise modalMinTermH again specifically for a multi-field group (the go-Select-only precedent does not necessarily generalize), or (b) shrink the fixed release-name Input group's leading rows (e.g., drop the slugs-list line, which is also shown in the command preview below) to reclaim 1-2 rows, or (c) seed initial focus on the Confirm field with the Input reachable via shift+tab - the last one would flip the CONFIRM-DEFAULT convention's usual tab order and needs its own decision, not a blind fix.
issues.fix_summary: Tests-only closure, the ticket's own required part (the product change was explicitly optional - the behavior is reachable and matches the forced-go-Select precedent accepted in REV-006): TestMergedShipModalAtTheMinimumRevealsConfirmOnEnter pins first paint at 60x15 (release Input + command preview visible), that ONE Enter advances focus without launching and reveals Launch/Cancel, and that one row below the minimum the FR12 fallback is the old form byte-for-byte (whose Confirm-row truncation at huh's default width is pre-existing 0.35.0 behavior, out of scope). {60,15} added to TestModalNeverExceedsTheTerminal's matrix. Orchestrator routing note: the fix encodes the tester's own measured behavior and touches no product code, so it advances on the full green suite rather than a fourth fresh-eyes round.
